implementations.notes: Dependency-free peer implementation of the deterministic core: registry, edge costs, min-risk multipath planner, and the shape/unit/license predicates. Written against the frozen semantics, certified by corpus reproduction — not a transliteration of the JavaScript.

interpretation: An implementation conforms when every case it DECLARES reproduces the corpus hash byte-for-byte after canonicalization. Coverage is the fraction of the corpus it declares; partial coverage is legitimate, a failing declared case is not.
